production.complexityPolicy: exact deterministic solving below a hard guard; explicit fail-closed complexity error above the guard

triplet.reason: The only SHA-pinned real-world score that reaches notation completion has one complete three-event triplet run and zero invalid runs. The remaining three files stop at pre-triplet notation blockers, so adding triplet provenance now would be speculative and would not fix their actual production failures.
triplet.futureRule: Re-open triplet provenance only if a reachable score demonstrates ambiguous or invalid triplet grouping after the pre-triplet limitation.

scopeDecision.phase14: Accept the two bounded-complexity failures and the one <=6-unit rhythm-representability failure as explicit fail-closed limitations for the initial Phase 14 MIDI profile.
